problem:
For the function $f:{R}^{2}\to R,$ defined as

$$
f(x,y)=x\operatorname{cos}⁡y+y\operatorname{sin}⁡x,
$$

the quadratic Taylor polynomial of $f$ about $a=[\begin{aligned}\frac{\pi }{2} \\ 0\end{aligned}]$ is given by

$$
f(x,y)≈f(a)+{f}^{′}(a)(x-a)+\frac{1}{2}{[\begin{aligned}∗ \\ y\end{aligned}]}^{T}[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 \\ 0 & ∗\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}∗ \\ y\end{aligned}].
$$

Find the sum of the three missing expressions.
